# @ffmpeg/ffmpeg 0.12.15 license provenance

The installed npm package omits its upstream license file. This copy comes from
ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm tag `v12.15`, commit
`71aa99d37c02a7b4c435275ca9ef50e612f6efa1`.
The package manifest at that commit declares `@ffmpeg/ffmpeg` version `0.12.15`.

Source: https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm/blob/71aa99d37c02a7b4c435275ca9ef50e612f6efa1/LICENSE

LICENSE SHA-256: `3e123e29517d76504ffce77b3f8e2ccffd4712493f27694b0aba3e376676459f`.
